entries.notes: Two sources extracted that address density-dependent sticking. PMC9013384 directly models effective sticking at compressed-gas densities (φ up to 1 = LHD) and shows density and temperature dependence of reactivation. nucl-ex/0101007 is an experimental paper using solid-hydrogen multilayer films (high-density geometry) by Markushin and Petitjean. Neither source specifically addresses DAC-compressed DT at densities above LHD (Acceleron's extreme high-density regime). The gap remains partially open: the literature covers density dependence up to LHD, but Acceleron's DAC conditions may exceed LHD significantly, where reactivation physics could differ. No publication specifically addresses sticking at super-LHD densities.
